snippet.title: SPELLCAST Spot Trailer
snippet.description:
SPELLCAST combines the strategy and deckbuilding of a card battler with the dynamic gameplay of word games. Battle through 10 different scenarios or the roguelite campaign, earning ranks and high scores!

Now in Early Access on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3821120/SPELLCAST/
